Bilingual Front Desk / Office Assistant – Join Our Purpose-Driven Pediatric Therapy Team
Work Location: 810 Lawrence Dr, Newbury Park, CA AND 1827 Knoll Dr, Ventura, CA
Part-Time (AM or PM shifts available; must be available for both office locations)
Potential to grow into a full-time position based on performance and clinic needs

Be the Friendly Face That Families Remember.

At Children’s Therapy Network (CTN), our Front Desk Team is the heart of the client experience. We’re seeking a Bilingual (English/Spanish) Front Desk / Office Assistant who is warm, reliable, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced pediatric environment. If you're passionate about helping others, love staying organized, and enjoy being the calm in the storm—this role is for you.

About Us

Children’s Therapy Network is a therapist-led pediatric practice providing Occupational, Physical, and Speech Therapy services across Ventura County. We serve over 500 families each year with compassion and excellence. Our Client Services team is more than reception—they are partners in delivering high-quality care and making every family feel supported from the moment they walk in.

What You’ll Do:

Be the first point of contact for families—greet, check in, and welcome each client warmly

Collect and process co-pays, deductibles, and explain basic insurance terms (we’ll teach you!)

Assist families with paperwork and clinic policies in a kind, clear way

Monitor and manage clinician schedules—ensuring they stay full and patients consistently attend

Follow up on cancellations, coordinate reschedules, and help prevent gaps in care

Keep the clinic clean, organized, and stocked—a tidy space helps everyone work better

Support internal communications, supply ordering, and assist with fun events and outings

Key Performance Indicator (KPI):

Your primary KPI as a Front Desk team member is to keep clinicians’ schedules full and clients attending their sessions consistently. When clients show up, kids make progress, and our entire mission thrives.

Additional Details:

You’ll rotate between our Newbury Park and Ventura locations

Shifts include arriving 15 minutes before opening and completing closing duties

Expect training and support to grow in your role—we’re invested in your success

This role has the opportunity to become full-time as our team continues to grow

Compensation & Bonus Structure:

We offer a competitive hourly rate plus a profit-sharing bonus structure—the better CTN does, the better you do. Your contributions directly support the clinic’s growth, and we believe in sharing that success.

✅ What You Bring:

Bilingual in English & Spanish (required)

High school diploma or GED (some college a plus)

Minimum 2 years of customer service or administrative experience

Friendly, professional demeanor with strong communication skills

Organized, able to multi-task, and stay calm under pressure

Basic computer skills (Google Drive, email, scheduling software)

A love for helping others and contributing to a collaborative team

❤️ Ready to Help Kids Thrive?

If you're a proactive, positive team player who loves connecting with families and supporting mission-driven care—we want to hear from you!

To apply: Send your resume and cover letter with the subject line:
“Front Desk Position – Your Name”

Summary

The primary job of the Front Desk Floater is to exceed patient expectations for outstanding customer service while creating a warm and caring environment. Front Desk Floaters are key players in the delivery of quality patient care which leads to great first and last impression to all our patients. Additionally, the Front Desk Floater is expected to cover any callouts, PTO’s or absences, which might require traveling to another site as well as schedule changes to work at least one Saturday a month depending on clinical need. They may also be required from time to time to support in training new FD Floaters, track their progress and report findings/progress/areas of improvement with clinic manager.

*This role will float between locations in the East LA region on an as-needed basis.

Duties and Responsibilities

Appointment System Management

Use of eClinicalWorks computerized patient management system including booking appointments, entering new patient information into the system and uploading scanned documents into individual patient records
Knowledgeable of services provided and required paperwork for each patient
Monitoring and updating patient status throughout the day
Attend all necessary trainings for all required updates and/or system upgrades

Managing Reception Area

Ensures high standard of customer care at all times
Has strong communication skills
Greets all patients and visitors in person or on the telephone with professionalism and answers patients questions
Responsible for pre-booking appointments in person or on the phone
Completes appointment reminders a day before to decrease no-show rate and offers to reschedule any cancelations
Optimizes patients' experience and provider time by monitoring schedules daily
Processes and collects patient payments and provides receipt
Maintains updates patient records by confirming patients demographics including financial information
Enforces all health and safety regulations including the protection of patients' rights by maintaining confidentiality of personal and financial information.
Follows policies and procedures
Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.
Other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS

High school graduate or its equivalency;
Experience in medical front office procedures preferred and knowledge of medical terminology;
Ability to always demonstrate the highest level of performance and behavior standards;
Excellent customer service skills and ability to effectively and respectfully handle dissatisfied patients;
Demonstrated attention to detail, ability to multi-task, and flexible;
Knowledge of standard office machines including copier, fax, multi-line telephone, printers, etc.;
Ability to be a team player; support and assist team members.

EEO - Via Care Community Health Center provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status, amnesty, or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. San Fernando Community Health Center complies with applicable state and local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the organization has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS

Valid California Driver’s License and automobile insurance coverage;
subject to a criminal background check prior to employment; and
TB clearance, and annual influenza to be renewed every year. COVID vaccine.

json.description:
*JOB SUMMARY:* To perform excellent customer/patient services. Essential duties include greeting incoming patients. The position is considered a crucial link between the patients and the care delivered by clinical and service staff. A medical receptionist must exemplify the core values and mission of the organization, always exercising utmost discretion, diplomacy and tact in patient/staff interactions.

*EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:*

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Two years experience as Medical Receptionist.

*ESSENTIAL SKILLS AND ABILITIES:*

* Problem solver
* Analytical
* Perfectionist
* Personable
* Organized
* Professional

*CORE RESPONSIBLITIES:*

* Welcomes and greets patients/clients/visitors to the in a warm and friendly manner; determines purpose of visit and direct patients/clients/visitors to appropriate person.
* Carefully screens patients for any changes such as new address, new insurance and updated insurance information.
* Verifies method of payment for service (Medicare, private insurances, private payee, etc.) and collects data and/ or payments appropriately.
* Checks patients’ in/out accurately, promptly in a courteous manner according to OC Surgical’s protocol.
* Schedule patients flow to clinic based on predetermined appointment arrangements to allow the clinic to serve an adequate number of patients as established by grant requirements.
* Adheres to all OC Surgical policies on safety and security.
* Must exercise utmost diplomacy and tact to provide excellent customer service for patients; practices confidentiality and privacy protocols in accordance to OC Surgical’s policies and HIPAA requirements.
* Maintains patient waiting areas, office files, and front-desk areas in a manner that is organized and neat.
* Informs patient of any existing balance noted in the system; collect copay for the date of service and request patient to be prepare for any payment due at time of visit.
* Allocate copays and payments adhering protocol.
* Ensures all HMO patients have the proper authorizations for the procedures and/or visits.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with patients, patients’ families and/or guardians, physicians, employees, and the public.
* Process report for any cash/check deposited by the end of the day; ensures petty cash and payments collected for the day is balanced.

*OTHER ESSENTIAL DUTIES:*

* Ability to maintain positive and pleasant demeanor at all times; work well under pressure with minimal supervision. Proven flexibility and willingness to handle a variety of tasks.
* Print and inform physicians with their schedules as assigned.
* Works effectively and serves as an effective “back-up” in other department when needed.
* Call all the no show patients by the end of the day to reschedule missed appointments.

*PHISYCAL DEMANDS:*

* Ability to continuously stand or walk.
* Ability to bend, squat when needed.
* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: From $20.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

Every Saturday & Sunday Evenings only

Job Summary: The Unit Secretary-Inpatient works under the direct supervision of a registered nurse. Performs secretarial and receptionist duties that contribute to the smooth operation of assigned unit/department that provides patient-centered care. Greets and screens the public upon arrival to unit/department. Recognizes potentially dangerous situations with visitors, patients and families and takes appropriate action. Assists with facilitating optimal patient flow and coordinates diagnostic testing as ordered by the physician/ nurse practitioner. Maintains supplies, equipment, and forms. Utilizes interpersonal skills to maximize customer service, safety, and professionalism. Contributes to a work environment of caring and cooperation among a culturally diverse workforce, patient/visitor population. Performs other duties as needed.

Education and Experience: High School Diploma or General Education Development (GED) required. Minimum one year of unit secretary experience preferred. Completion of one year of college or minimum of one year of experience in medical field preferred.

Knowledge and Skills: Basic knowledge of medical terminology, Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) and patient rights required. Able to read; write legibly; speak in English (and Spanish preferred) and relate and communicate positively, effectively, and professionally with others; use computer, printer, and software programs necessary to the position; operate and troubleshoot equipment required for the position; perform unit secretarial and clerical activities as needed for position; be assertive and consistent in following policies; work calmly and respond courteously when under pressure; accept and follow directions; perform basic math functions; manage multiple assignments effectively; organize and prioritize workload; collaborate with nurse in charge to problem solve; recall information with accuracy; pay close attention to detail; function within scope of practice; distinguish colors, hear sufficiently for general conversation in person and on the telephone; identify and distinguish various sounds associated with the work place; see adequately to read computer screens, medical records, and written documents necessary to position.

Licensures and Certifications: Basic Life Support (BLS) Certification through the American Heart Association as required in the Department Plan for Providing Care and may be obtained during orientation process.

We have an excellent opportunity for a Medical Receptionist to join our team. Family & Industrial Medical Center (FIMC) is the area’s leading provider of primary care, walk-in urgent care, and industrial medicine. The Medical Receptionist is the first point of contact for our patients which requires a positive and welcoming attitude. The receptionist is responsible for efficient, professional, and customer-focused patient care activities include working in an electronic medical records (EMR) system, answering patient calls in a multi-line phone system, checking patients in/out, collecting/handling money, and various other duties based upon the front office needs.

We are looking for candidates who can operate in a multifaceted, fast paced but manageable team environment that requires quick decision making and attention to detail. The position may include both weekday and weekend hours, including some holidays and closing shifts.

json.description:
*Surgery Scheduler | Full-Time | Surgery Center | Encino, CA*

*About the Surgery Scheduler Position:*

Seeking a *highly organized, proactive Surgery Scheduler* to join a fast-paced *Ambulatory Surgery Center in Encino, CA.* This is a *key role* in the facility, responsible for coordinating *200+ surgical cases per week* across *12 specialties* while ensuring seamless scheduling and operational efficiency.

As the *primary Surgery Scheduler,* you will work closely with the Business Office Manager. While you’ll have a *dedicated data entry assistant* to handle administrative tasks, *your focus will be on scheduling, optimization, and physician relations.*

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced surgical setting, enjoys building relationships with physician offices, and is eager to take ownership of a critical role in the center’s operations.

*Surgery Scheduler Role Details:*

* *Location:* Encino, CA
* *Salary:* $25 - $28 per hour _(based on relevant surgical scheduling experience, candidates with minimal surgical scheduling experience may start at the lower end of the pay range)._
* *Schedule:* Full-time, Monday – Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM
* *Benefits Upon Eligibility:* 401(k), Medical, Vision, Dental, Paid Holidays, Paid Time Off, Sick Days

*Surgery Scheduler Responsibilities: Surgery Scheduling & Coordination*

* Manage scheduling for *200 surgical cases per week* across *12 specialties* while ensuring proper coordination between *physicians, patients, and facilities.*
* Schedule procedures with hospitals and surgery centers, manage pre-op testing, and oversee all necessary documentation.
* Proactively track *physician vacations and time-off requests* to minimize last-minute scheduling gaps.

*Schedule Optimization & Physician Relations*

* *Own* the surgery schedule—maximize efficiency by actively filling open slots, ensuring no unused OR time.
* Call and email *6-8 weeks in advance* to confirm schedules and proactively offer alternative options rather than rejecting cases.
* Understand the *specialty-specific equipment requirements* and how they impact scheduling.

*Operational Communication & Equipment Coordination*

* Work closely with *Pre-op, OR, and Post-op staff* to manage last-minute cancellations, add-ons, and adjustments.
* Ensure all *necessary equipment* (X-ray, microscope, GI tower, Koelis, ESWL table) is available and confirm technician availability.
* Consolidate rooms as needed in response to cancellations or schedule changes.

*Surgery Scheduler Qualifications:*

* *1+ year of surgery scheduling or related experience required.*
* Strong *communication skills* for interacting with physicians, patients, and staff.
* *Knowledge of medical procedures, terminology, and office operations.*
* Comfortable with *high-volume phone interactions* (8-10 outreach calls per day).
* Ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods; lift up to 25 lbs.

*Why This Role is Unique:*

* *Direct Mentorship & Support:* You will report directly to the Business Office Manager, who will provide hands-on support to ensure your success.
* *Diverse Specialties:* You’ll be scheduling across *12 different specialties,* requiring a strong ability to coordinate complex surgical cases and understand equipment needs.

*Apply Today!*

We are actively reviewing applications and scheduling interviews. If you're ready to *take ownership of a fast-paced scheduling role* and work directly with leadership to optimize surgical operations, *apply today!* We look forward to meeting you.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $25.00 - $28.00 per hour

Benefits:
* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
